policies.title: Algerian ordinary passports: Bangladesh advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's Embassy in Algiers provides a mission application process and tourist requirements for Algerian nationals.
conditions: Complete the online form and submit the required passport, photograph, tourist documents and fee through Bangladesh's Embassy process before travel.
Applies to an ordinary Algerian passport holder travelling as a short visitor; work, residence, official travel, transit and final admission are outside scope.

application.label: Bangladesh Embassy in Algiers visa instructions
steps: Complete and print the official online visa form.
Prepare the passport, photograph, tourist invitation, itinerary, reservation and fee.
Submit the application through the Embassy before travel.

policies.title: Algerian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Algeria as requiring a visa prior to arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Algerian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Algerian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Algerian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Algerian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Algerian ordinary passports: Mongolia electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's official eVisa service lists Algeria and delivers the approved electronic authorization before travel.
conditions: Apply online, pay the fee and receive the approved electronic document by email before travel.
The passport must have at least 180 days of validity when applying; carry a copy for arrival scanning.
Applies to short visitor travel; work, residence, transit-specific rules and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Mongolia eVisa application
application.processingTime: The Immigration Agency states up to three working days / 72 hours.
steps: Receive the approved electronic document by email and carry it for arrival.

policies.title: Algerian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Algeria in its authorized-visa cohort for advance consular approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Algerian passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Apply in person at the competent Panamanian consulate before travel; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that the separate third-country-document waiver does not apply.
Submit the required documents in person to the competent Panamanian consulate.
Travel only after the authorized visa is granted.

conflicts.explanation: Bangladesh's current Embassy in Algiers instructions require Algerian visitors to submit a mission visa application; the online form is printed for submission and is not an eVisa.
Mongolia's official eVisa portal expressly lists Algeria and delivers the approved electronic document before travel.
